title: JustHorse
description: Horse plugin for your Hub server
body:
This is a small, lightweight and fully customizable plugin for your hub server.

Type /horse to summon it for you

![Common horse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/264ab237fdf20ae93f156672934871c91905b141.png)

And after by opening horse inventory you can customize it!
![Horse settings menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0050f4599a02b5e0575fea71c7bab7b871637f9.png)

Here you can change strength, color, style and armor of your horse.
By different permissions you can give best settings only for donaters.
